description: A grand farmhouse living room with a soaring cathedral ceiling clad in wide reclaimed wood planks in a weathered grey-brown tone, supported by heavy exposed timber cross beams. The walls are smooth warm plaster in a creamy off-white. On both sides of the room, black-framed multi-pane casement windows fitted with white woven roman shades let in bright daytime light. On the far right, a full-height black steel-framed glass door or window provides additional light. An arched doorway is partially visible at the far left. The fireplace wall at center is flanked by the two windows, with a white-plastered chimneybreast and simple surround. A flatscreen television is mounted above the mantel. A large U-shaped sofa in white or cream linen fabric with multiple cushions occupies the center of the room. Two matching upholstered armchairs in cream flanking a round drum coffee table in pale natural oak complete the seating arrangement. The coffee table is styled with a large white ceramic vase of white lily blooms, a round low bowl in putty, and several art books. Behind the sofa, a long low media console in light oak with panel doors and open cubby shelving holds books, bowls, and small ceramic vessels. A flat natural wool rug in ivory grounds the whole arrangement. The atmosphere is warm and airy — architectural grandeur softened by natural linen and warm wood. Camera is at standing eye-level, shooting with a wide lens from the far end of the room in a centered symmetrical composition that captures the full vaulted ceiling, fireplace, and seating group.
